semantics.tile: 49 rotating1/128 per-pass/layer helper samples and complete stable eligible-frame pass/loop totals, rebased to exact52
semantics.batch: Every eligible-frame TileBatch.End and the4 upload/indexed-submit callsites in RenderBatch/FlushLayered; whole-frame coarse donation only when stack/timing/scopes are complete and valid
semantics.discard: BATCH_STATE.frames equals STATE.eligible; valid_frames+discarded_frames=frames. Game scope aborts discard that frame coarse metrics but do not alone set global measurement_invalid. Observer/clock/overflow errors discard coarse data and set global measurement_invalid. Excluded/incomplete-capture frames donate neither batch frame counts nor metrics. clock_calls/aborted_scopes/observer_failures in BATCH_STATE refer to eligible frames, including discarded frames.
semantics.overflow: Before eligible scene/pass/batch donation, preflight STATE eligible and batch frame/diagnostic counters together. If unrepresentable, exclude all eligible donation for that frame and set sticky measurement_invalid; never saturate. Metric-only merge overflow discards coarse metrics if discarded-frame accounting remains representable. Arbitrarily corrupted prior counters are not promised coherent recovery.
semantics.observer_failures: Coalesced at most once per eligible observer-faulty discarded frame, so observer_failures <= discarded_frames. A nonthrowing flags-only RuntimeFault preserves old tile behavior and additionally invalidates current coarse metrics for tile/snapshot/clock/overflow faults, including before batch stack initialization. Original game scope aborts are not observer faults.
semantics.time: Only complete valid-frame scopes donate timing/Call counts. Exclusive means inclusive minus timed immediate children, retaining observer/untracked work; not pure CPU. No GPU fence, query or FNA change.
